**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast-style snack: two slices of toast on a small paper plate, with two jam packets (strawberry) and a cup of black coffee on a tray.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Small white paper plate, roughly 15 cm diameter. Area = 3.14 × (7.5)² ≈ 177 cm². The coffee cup and jam packets are not food on the plate; the coffee is a separate beverage and I will not count it in the plate meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:** (1) Two slices of toast (one slice is partly overlapping the other), (2) strawberry jam packets (two, sitting on the tray beside the plate, not on the plate), (3) black coffee in the cup, which is a beverage, not part of the plated food.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Toast covers about 60% of the plate (two slices, overlapping). Jam packets are off the plate, so 0% of plate area.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Toast: 106 cm² × 1.0 cm ≈ 106 ml (thin slices, about 1 cm thick overall including overlap).

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Bread-like slices, density 0.9-1.0 g/ml. Toast 106 ml × 0.9 ≈ 95 g. (Two slices of bread typically weigh about 60-70 g, so I'll keep the visible toast closer to 70 g, reflecting the thinness and browning.)

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Toast ≈ 270 kcal/100 g → 70 g ≈ 190 kcal. Strawberry jam, two single-serve packets (~14 g each, about 28 g total) at ~250 kcal/100 g → ~70 kcal. Coffee, black, is about 2 kcal per cup and is negligible here, but I'll include it for completeness since it is in the scene.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Two toast slices plus two jam packets, with black coffee, is a plausible light breakfast. Roughly 70 g of toast and about 190 kcal fits a few slices of bread. Jam adds a modest amount of sugar-based energy.

Total on plate (toast only): ~70 g, ~190 kcal. Including jam packets: ~98 g, ~260 kcal.
